message.reasoning_content:
Analyze and record description. Key risks: A&S polynomial gives Phi(x) with absolute error ~1e-7 relative to erf — actual absolute error of approximation is about 7.5e-8 in erfc, so GELU error = |x| * 7.5e-8 ≤ 65504*7.5e-8 ≈ 5e-3 >> 1e-6 for large |x|. At x=65504, GELU(x)≈x, error ~ x*7.5e-8 ~ 0.005. Definitely exceeds 1e-6 for large magnitudes. Also FP16 extreme values: exp(-0.5*x^2) underflows to 0 for |x|>~27 (fp32 exp underflow ~ exp(-87), 0.5x²>87 at |x|>13.2 gives subnormal; at |x|>~19 exp underflows to 0). Then tail=0, probability for x<0 = 0, output 0 — correct. For x>0, prob=1, output x — correct. So errors mid-range |x| in ~4..20? Error x*7.5e-8 exceeds 1e-6 when |x|>13. But at |x|>~13.2 exp underflow... exp(-87)≈1e-38 still normal in fp32 until -87.4 log: 0.5x² = 87 → |x|≈13.2. Underflow to subnormal until 0.5x²=103 → |x|≈14.35, then 0. So errors exceed 1e-6 for |x| between ~13 and 14.3, plus polynomial rounding. Also for moderate |x|, e.g., |x|=10, error ~7.5e-7 — borderline. The A&S absolute error is 1.5e-7 actually (error bound |epsilon| ≤ 1.5e-7 in Phi). Then x*1.5e-7 exceeds 1e-6 at |x|>6.7. So risk.

Also the polynomial coefficients: standard A&S uses t*P(t) with those coefficients; here Horner: p = ((((1.06141 t -1.45315) t +1.42141) t -0.28450) t +0.25483) t. That matches. Composed: for x≥0, Phi(x) = 1 - tail where tail = 0.5*poly*exp(-x²/2). Correct composition (A&S 7.1.26 uses exp(-x²/2)).

Other risks: `tl.div_rn` correctness, masked other=0.0 → x=0 for inactive lanes fine. Signed zero: x=-0.0, x<0.0 false → prob=1-0.5*poly(0)... at x=0, t=1, poly=1.06141-1.45315+1.42141-0.2845+0.25483 ≈ 1.00000? Sum: 1.06141-1.45315=-0.39174; +1.42141=1.02967; -0.28450=0.74517; +0.25483=1.00000. Good. envelope=1, tail=0.5, prob=0.5, value=-0.0*0.5=-0.0 — sign of zero: for -0.0 output is -0.0; target GELU(-0)= 0.5*(-0)*erfc(0)= -0? Contract says signed zeros equivalent. OK.

For subnormals, fine.
